results.title: AccountsIQ and Abacum team up on finance intelligence
results.content:
AccountsIQ, a cloud accounting platform built for mid-market organisations, has entered into a strategic partnership with Abacum, an AI-native financial planning and analysis provider, in a move designed to give finance teams a fully connected stack spanning accounting through to strategic planning. [...] As part of the tie-up, Abacum will function as an intelligence layer sitting above AccountsIQ’s data, linking financial information across systems in real time. The two firms describe the partnership as part of a broader shift within European finance functions, away from historical reporting and towards forward-looking planning supported by AI. [...] AccountsIQ will continue to handle multi-entity, multi-currency accounting, while Abacum layers AI-driven planning and forecasting capability on top, joining the two into a single workflow that runs from initial recordkeeping through reporting and into forward planning.

The companies said the combined offering is intended to give finance teams more certainty in their figures while freeing up time for teams to take on a more strategic role within their organisations.
